paths: Each job has a private run root. Output and log paths are relative to that root. The command is the submitted executable argv or the tracked launcher and profile, with transport and access identifiers removed.

symbols.$SOURCE: protected revision checked by the job

limits: Scheduler success establishes completion of the submitted job. A diagnostic can succeed while demonstrating a failed acceptance check. A null sampled peak means Slurm returned zero or had no workload-step RSS measurement. Pending runs have no final exit code. Cancelled jobs may have no output or log files.
